description: This file defines the GatewayDeviceAuthPayload utility with methods for building authentication payload strings, normalizing metadata fields, and creating signed device dictionaries, primarily used in device authentication workflows.

methods.name: buildV3
methods.description: Constructs a version 3 authentication payload string by concatenating various device and client parameters with normalization and joining.

methods.name: normalizeMetadataField
methods.description: Normalizes metadata strings by trimming whitespace and converting uppercase ASCII letters to lowercase.

methods.name: signedDeviceDictionary
methods.description: Generates a dictionary containing signed device identity information, including signature, public key, and metadata.
